name: package-intelligence
title_zh: 查包先看下载曲线，不看注册表那行数字
tagline_zh: 训练数据里的「这个库很火」早就过期了。它去拉 PyPI 和 npm 的真实下载量、环比增速。
tagline_en: Training data's "this library is popular" is stale. It pulls real PyPI/npm download counts, MoM growth.
desc_en: Measure real-world adoption of PyPI and npm packages — downloads, month-over-month growth, competitive comparison, corporate ownership, dependency risk, and category trends. Use whenever a question involves how popular, how fast-growing, how healthy, or how widely depended-upon a software package is, instead of answering from (stale) training data or fetching a registry page.
why_zh: 不靠记忆答，也不让你自己去翻 registry 页面。下载量、增速、竞品、归属方一次拉齐。
why_en: No recall, no manual registry browsing. Downloads, growth, rivals, and ownership in one pass, plus a look down the dependency.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 PyPI 和 npm 两个生态，Cargo、Go modules、Maven 一律不答；下载量是代理指标。
limit_en: PyPI and npm only — no Cargo, Go modules, or Maven. Download counts are a proxy, not real usage; private packages and mirror traffic aren't counted.
title_en: Package adoption numbers, not stale guesses
